{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.90.37","title":"wg: partial-02 L401 The replaced RFC 9420 step includes LeafNode validation (Section 7.3)...","description":"draft-ietf-mls-partial (partial-02), Joining via Annotated Welcome. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-partial at 7fef7c1, L401.

Text: "The "Verify the integrity of the ratchet tree" step is replaced with a
     check that the `tree_hash` in the GroupInfo matches the root tree hash
     produced by the membership proofs."

Problem: The replaced RFC 9420 step includes LeafNode validation (Section 7.3) and credential validation. The draft never requires a partial client to validate the LeafNode or credential in any membership proof it uses. Partial Member Identity Authentication (line 635) nevertheless assumes the proved credential is valid.

Suggested fix: Require that each LeafNode taken from a membership proof and used for signature verification or identity be validated per RFC 9420 Section 7.3, including credential validation with the AS, before use.

Severity: medium. Verifier: narrow (The replaced step does include leaf validation and parent-hash checks, and nothing requires AS credential validation of leaves received in proofs. Line 621 claims invariant preservation at full members, so the "unsupported claim" part is a misreading and is dropped.)
